name: obs_unexpected_error_count
description: Count of unexpected backend server errors from request.summary
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="__BACKEND_SERVICE__" AND (textPayload=~"\"message\":\"request[.]summary\"" OR jsonPayload.message="request.summary") AND (textPayload=~"\"outcome_class\":\"server_error\"" OR jsonPayload.outcome_class="server_error")
